A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same InnoGym research. Their complete main texts, equations, seven figures, thirteen tables and appendices support reliable comparison despite section relocation and pagination changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original agent evaluations in Table 2, controlled experiments in Section 4.3, and statistical analyses and human validation in Appendices D–F.

after.justification: v2 retains the original agent evaluations, controlled experiments, statistical analyses and human validation, with the corresponding appendix material now in Appendices E–G.

M1.justification: The performance-gain and novelty framework, solution-extraction and comparison procedures, benchmark construction, and iGym architecture are unchanged. The complete extraction, comparison and innovation prompts are retained.

E1.justification: Both retain the same eighteen-task benchmark, ten-task main evaluation, CirclePacking analyses, EquiBench variants, three AI-subfield method-triplet cases and ROADEF evaluator checks. No evaluated domain or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains MLAB, CODEACT and AIDE with the same leaderboard references. The backbone comparisons, standard-versus-innovation prompting comparison, and agent-versus-human comparisons also retain their comparator membership.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 retains the same main backbone, ten-task subset, twelve-hour budget and evaluation metrics. The runtime, temperature and backbone experiments, data partitions, and triplet sampling and annotation protocols are unchanged.

E4.justification: Both contain the same prior-solution refinement, runtime, backbone, temperature, submission-success and explicit-novelty-prompt analyses. The distance-function validation and evaluator checks are also retained; appendix renumbering adds no analysis.

E5.justification: Both report three main runs with best-valid-run selection and the same repeated-run information in Figure 6. Tables 4–5 retain the 10,000-resample task bootstrap, 95% confidence intervals and paired bootstrap tests.

E6.justification: The numerical tables and plotted results match. For example, Table 2 retains mean ratios of -0.45, -0.69 and -0.64 for MLAB, CODEACT and AIDE, respectively. Appendix results and the findings shown in Figures 5–6 are unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(4), the reference-diversity formula and formal task taxonomy are retained. The contextual-relativity and temporal-update discussion moves unchanged from Section 2.4 to Appendix I.1; no mathematical definition, derivation or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract and introduction retain the same contributions: joint performance-gain/novelty evaluation, eighteen standardized tasks, iGym, and evidence that robustness limits effective innovation. Removing the conclusion's aspirational closing sentence does not alter these scientific claims.

C2.justification: The interpretations of robustness, novelty–performance trade-offs and human agreement are unchanged. All four limitations are retained under Appendix B, and the properties-of-innovation discussion is relocated rather than revised. The new ethics statement adds no substantive scientific qualification.

D1.justification: v1 labels the repository 'Coming soon'; v2 removes that qualifier and adds a reproducibility statement reporting release of the benchmark, dataset and framework at the same repository. This changes documented resource availability, while implementation details, prompts and settings remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, benchmark positioning in Table 1 and bibliography are unchanged. No cited work or substantive relationship to prior research is added or removed.

P1.justification: v2 moves Section 2.4 to Appendix I.1, makes Limitations Appendix B, renumbers subsequent appendices, and adds ethics, reproducibility and acknowledgment sections plus conference-status text. The conclusion is lightly shortened; most prose is unchanged. Some updated extraction-prompt references misleadingly point to I.1, titled 'Properties of Innovation'.

P2.justification: The figures and tables retain their content and design but shift within the layout: Figure 4 moves from page 7 to page 6, and Figure 6 from page 10 to page 9. Appendix tables reflow, prompt boxes follow the relocated discussion, and conference headers are added.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves reproducibility documentation by replacing 'Coming soon' with an explicit release statement covering the benchmark, dataset and framework. The scientific evidence is unchanged. Misleading prompt cross-references remain, limiting the editorial benefit; the PDFs support improved availability reporting without independently establishing repository contents.
